pages.text: In a spinning rotor the heavier molecule crowds to the wall: the separation factor is α = e^(Δm v²/2RT). A stage passes on a fraction θ (the cut) of its feed, enriched by β = 1 + (α − 1)(1 − θ); n stages multiply the isotope ratio by βⁿ. Every layer of the tower is a stage.
$(thing)Set$(): Rotor peripheral speed, Cut θ.$(br2)$(thing)Disturbance$(): Rotor imbalance: the speed wanders by ±1%·d.

$(thing)Limits$(): Rotor stress above what carbon fibre safely holds; The rotors are sitting on a flexural resonance; Safeguards interlock: product above 20% U-235; Uranium hexafluoride freezing onto the rotor walls.$(br2)$(thing)Rate$(): A bigger cut, and a taller tower, pass more product.

$(thing)Equations$()$(br)Rotor speed: v·(1 + 0.01·d)$(br)Gas temperature: T_gas = T + 20 K$(br)Separation factor α: α = e^(Δm v²/2RT)$(br)Stage enrichment β: β = 1 + (α − 1)(1 − θ)$(br)Stages: n$(br)Product assay: x_P = R_F βⁿ/(1 + R_F βⁿ)$(br)Rotor hoop stress: σ = ρv²
